title: Require Package Publication Coherence
forbids: an implicit package visibility decision, publication metadata on a private project, or a public project without explicit npm classification
why: Project kind and distribution are independent. An application, service, resource, plugin, or package becomes public only through one coherent package and Nx classification.
remediate: Declare private explicitly. Keep private projects free of publishConfig and npm:public, or classify a public product with private false, public publishConfig, and the npm:public Nx tag.
message: Workspace package visibility and publication metadata must agree.
